rules.structure: one block-final word per language for the block 2 «Europe» review; Challenge GeoWords reuse the approved review words of block 2 sections 1-5
rules.approval: approval.contentSha256 = first 16 hex of sha256 over {answer, definition}
rules.definitions: a definition never contains its answer word, nor a word of the same root

en.definition: A highly developed society with cities, writing, laws, science and art, like that of the ancient Greeks and Romans.

ru.definition: Высокий уровень развития общества: города, письменность, законы, науки и искусства. Так жили, например, древние греки и римляне.
